Soft-Side-Table-3D download, Textures/ (black and grey colours, oak and smoked oak). Beige Green and Orange are calibrated to Muuto's packshots and lifestyle photos: the download's #cbbf77 and #da6e01/#ed7f32 render far more saturated than the real finishes. The download has no Beige Green top colour; top and base are the same colour in Muuto's photos.
note: Every top and base is sold in every size; the price depends on the size and the top. No white base is sold in any Muuto market (bases: 01 Black, 02 Grey, 03 Beige Green, 04 Orange). Muuto's materials text also mentions an Off-white linoleum top, which its configurator no longer offers.

groups.label: Base
groups.note: Muuto sells four base colours for every size (Black, Grey, Beige Green, Orange) and no white; Grey, the palest, is the default.
